description: This file contains an abstract class 'GeneralizedReferenceTypeSurrogateCodec' implementing serialization logic for reference types with surrogate serialization. It provides methods to read and write such objects, converting between the object and its surrogate representation.

classes.name: GeneralizedReferenceTypeSurrogateCodec
classes.description: Abstract generic class for surrogate serialization of reference types, supporting conversion to and from a surrogate type.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value of type TField from the reader, potentially using a surrogate for deserialization.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a TField object, converting it to a surrogate if necessary, and writes it to the buffer.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a surrogate type into the actual field type.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a field type to its surrogate representation.
